summary: Comprehensive architectural refactoring and feature expansion plan for Ledger Smart, including modular Context/Hooks architecture, a collapsible grouped sidebar with a global Command Palette (Cmd+K), unified modal/confirmation management, offline-first local caching with a Supabase sync queue, Multi-Account & Wallet tracking, Net Worth & Debt Payoff Planner (Snowball/Avalanche), and a Smart Receipt Scanner & CSV/Bank Statement Bulk Importer powered by Gemini.
